run_sft_vlm_training: run supervised fine-tuning on a vision-language model using SFTTrainer with text-image pairs
create_collate_fn_vlm: create a data collator function to encode text and image pairs with masked labels for vision-language training
load_vision_language_model: load a vision-to-sequence model and processor from HuggingFace for multimodal fine-tuning
configure_peft_quantization: configure PEFT and quantization settings for efficient vision-language model fine-tuning
train_push_vision_model: train a vision-language model and push the trained model and processor to HuggingFace Hub
